connector.name: Pickle
connector.registryDescription: Free, local MCP server that audits ClickUp, Slack & Teams for work that slipped through.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package pickle-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the adityaarsharma account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: CLICKUP_API_KEY
env.description: Your own ClickUp personal API token (starts with pk_). Optional — set it to enable the 9 ClickUp audit patterns.

env.name: SLACK_TOKEN
env.description: Your own Slack user OAuth token (starts with xoxp-). Optional — set it to enable the cross-tool Slack patterns.

env.name: TEAMS_TOKEN
env.description: Your own Microsoft Graph access token. Optional — set it to enable the Microsoft Teams patterns.
